import SwiftUI
struct NestedArms: View {
    var body: some View {
        Image("x")
        #if os(iOS)
        #if DEBUG
        .accessibilityLabel("Debug")
        #else
        .accessibilityLabel("Release")
        #endif
        #else
        .accessibilityLabel("Other")
        #endif
    }
}

import SwiftUI
struct NestedUnnamed: View {
    var body: some View {
        Image("x")
        #if os(iOS)
        #if DEBUG
        .accessibilityLabel("Debug")
        #else
        .padding()
        #endif
        #else
        .accessibilityLabel("Other")
        #endif
    }
}

import SwiftUI
struct NestedThenSibling: View {
    var body: some View {
        Image("x")
        #if os(iOS)
        #if DEBUG
        .padding()
        #else
        .padding()
        #endif
        Text("sibling").accessibilityLabel("Sibling")
        #else
        .accessibilityLabel("Other")
        #endif
    }
}

messages.fixed-font-size: literal point size, which Dynamic Type cannot scale; use a text style, or Font.custom(_:size:), which scales with the body style
messages.unlabeled-image: image without an accessibility label; add .accessibilityLabel(...) or mark it decorative with .accessibilityHidden(true)
